title: Elegant Velvety Japanese Tofu Kaiseki Course
description: A plant-based Japanese dish featuring velvety tofu, umami flavors, and freshly chopped parsley, inspired by the cuisine of Okinawa.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Start by rehydrating the kombu seaweed sheets in 2 cups of water for 30 minutes.
In a blender or food processor, blend the rehydrated kombu, miso paste, mirin, and rice vinegar to create a smooth sauce.
In a large skillet, heat 1 teaspoon of sesame oil over medium heat and add the cubed tofu, cooking until golden brown on all sides.
Add the blended sauce to the skillet with the tofu and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the dish with salt to taste.
Serve the velvety tofu hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
